quests.name: Contract: Kill Thonar Silver-Blood
quests.plugin: Additional Contracts For the Dark Brotherhood.esp
quests.canDoWhy: An extra Dark Brotherhood contract you accept, then report back to Nazir in the Falkreath Sanctuary.

needs.what: Be a member of the Dark Brotherhood

starts.where: the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary near Falkreath
starts.how: Accept the additional contract to kill Thonar Silver-Blood; Nazir is the one who pays you when it's done.

rewards.what: A leveled reward item (large quest reward)

people.name: Thonar Silver-Blood
people.role: the target; placed in the Treasury House in Markarth, where his daily routine keeps him

people.name: Nazir
people.role: pays you at the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary

unsure.why: Probably Nazir. No line in these files sets the contract going. Every sister contract in this mod pays out through Nazir, and on the Elenwen contract his line is the only one tied to it, from before it starts until the reward. The other line tied to this contract is Thonar's own, only while the contract is fresh, which fits him talking to you as the target, not handing it out.
No start condition is in these files; Dark Brotherhood membership is inferred from the contract going through Nazir.
Thonar's record is marked essential in these files; how the mod lets you kill him isn't shown.
The leveled reward item is named by the quest's script, not shown being handed over; the journal only says you collect a reward from Nazir.

Nazir is placed in the Falkreath Sanctuary and just wanders where he is. If you've gone far in the Brotherhood story, the family may have moved to the Dawnstar Sanctuary (Babette's records send her there after Hail Sithis!); Nazir's records don't show a move either way.
Thonar also has a part in The Forsworn Conspiracy and No One Escapes Cidhna Mine. Whether killing him first breaks or changes those isn't shown here.
